an4.62:1.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca :-- 2.
an4.62:2.1: Cattār' imāni gahapati sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā kāmabhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāya.
an4.62:3.2: Idha gahapati kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā,
an4.62:3.3: so--bhogā me atthi uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā . . . dhammaladdhā ti--adhigacchati sukhaṃ adhigacchati somanassaṃ.
an4.62:4.2: Idha gahapati kulaputto uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sedāvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi bhoge ca bhuñjati puññāni ca karoti,
an4.62:4.3: so--uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatehi bhogehi . . . dhammaladdhehi bhoge ca bhuñjāmi puññāni ca karomīti--adhigacchati sukhaṃ adhigacchati somanassaṃ.
an4.62:5.2: Idha gahapati kulaputto na kassa kiñci dhāreti appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā,
an4.62:5.3: so-- na kassa kiñci dhāremi appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā ti--adhigacchati sukhaṃ adhigacchati somanassaṃ.
an4.62:6.2: Idha gahapati ariyasāvako anavajjena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti anavajjena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti anavajjena manokammena samannāgato hoti,
an4.62:6.3: so-- anavajjen' amhi kāyakammena samannāgato . . . manokammena samannāgato ti--adhigacchati sukhaṃ adhigacchati somanassaṃ.
an4.62:6.5: Imāni kho gahapati cattāri sukhāni adhigamanīyāni gihinā bhoginā kālena kālaṃ samayena samayaṃ upādāyāti. 2.
